ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The mountain body of Mount Putuo in Zhejiang Province is mainly composed of granite. What was the “diamond gemstone” (such as the “flying stone” in the figure) formed from? <image1>
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, a relatively large rounded boulder can be seen, with a form like an isolated stone egg or residual rock block; on its surface there are cracks, carved characters, and uneven weathering traces, and there is also bedrock supporting the boulder below. Then reason: the question stem states that the mountain body of Mount Putuo in Zhejiang Province is mainly composed of granite, and the rounded isolated-stone form of the “flying stone/diamond gemstone” in the figure accords with the characteristics of a spheroidal weathering body and residual boulder formed after granite has long been weathered along joints. Therefore it is not an extraterrestrial meteorite, but was formed by long-term weathering of local granite.
